Data Retention Policy

This policy defines how long operational data is kept. It was approved by the Security Council.

Logs

  • Application logs must be retained for 90 days.
  • Audit logs must be retained for 365 days.
  • Staging logs must be retained for 14 days.

Backups

Database backups must be retained for 35 days. Backups must be encrypted.

Support data

Customer support tickets are retained for 2 years after closure.
